narr: A closed low propagated from SW CONUS and rapidly intensified over the southeast Colorado plains. A combination of strong lift due to the rapidly intensifying cyclone and orographic lift created heavy snow over the mountains. Since this was a late spring system with origins from the Pacific, the lower elevations were warm enough for heavy rainfall that ended up causing some flooding issues along the Fountain Creek in El Paso County and Pueblo County.
ev: There was 1 foot of standing water as reported via video from law enforcement and social media.
